entries.name: degrade-leak-not98-accept#0
entries.description: Output 0's tree is size-flagged v3 (0b0ad1efefefefefefefeffd): BoolToSigmaProp, 8 LogicalNot, then unknown opcode 0xfd at depth 10. CheckValidOpCode throws a ValidationException, the tree degrades to UnparsedErgoTree, and the 10 levels are never lowered again (ErgoTreeSerializer.scala:209-211 restores only the position limit). Output 1's tree body is BoolToSigmaProp(LogicalNot^98(placeholder)): 10 + 98 + 2 = 110 = MaxTreeDepth. Round-trip identity.

entries.name: degrade-leak-not99-reject#1
entries.description: The same tx with output 1's tree body LogicalNot^99: 10 + 99 + 2 = 111 > MaxTreeDepth, rejected at parse. On a fresh level it would take 101 and parse (the blesser's control), so an impl that restores the level after the degrade round-trips the tx: the over-accept.
